hmong: Kuv hnov tau mob hauv kuv xub pwg.
english: I feel pain in my shoulder.

hmong: Thov mloog tus kws kho mob cov lus qhia.
english: Please listen to the doctor's instructions.

hmong: Kuv hnov suab nag los rau saum ru tsev.
english: I hear rain falling on the roof.

hmong: Tsis txhob khawb qhov txhab ntawd vim nws yuav mob ntxiv.
english: Do not scratch that wound because it may hurt more.

hmong: Nws tshee vim huab cua txias heev.
english: They are shivering because the weather is very cold.

hmong: Cov zaub kib tsw qab thoob plaws hauv tsev.
english: The stir-fried vegetables smell delicious throughout the house.

hmong: Thov tsis txhob chwv lub qhov txhab ntawd.
english: Please do not touch that wound.

hmong: Kuv rua lo ntau zaus vim kuv pw tsis txaus.
english: I yawn many times because I did not get enough sleep.

hmong: Kev tawm dag zog pab kom lub cev muaj zog.
english: Exercise helps keep the body strong.

hmong: Nws muaj ib qho hiav dub me me ntawm nws txhais tes.
english: They have a small dark spot on their hand.

hmong: Nws caij lub maus taus mus ua haujlwm txhua tag kis.
english: They ride a motorcycle to work every morning.

hmong: Tus ntxhais caij lub tsheb kauj vab mus kawm ntawv.
english: The girl rides a bicycle to school.

hmong: Peb tsav lub tsheb mus tom khw.
english: We drive the car to the store.

hmong: Lub tsheb nqaj hlau tuaj txog ntawm qhov chaw nres tsheb raws sijhawm.
english: The train arrived at the station on time.
note: `chaw nres tsheb` is glossed 'a parking place' in phr-chaw-nres-tsheb; here it is used as 'station'

hmong: Lub dav hlau yuav tsaws rau Lub Nroog Minneapolis yav tav su.
english: The airplane will land in Minneapolis in the afternoon.

hmong: Kuv caij lub npav mus hauv nroog thaum sawv ntxov.
english: I take the bus into the city in the morning.
note: the model wrote the English word `downtown`

hmong: Peb hu lub tsheb ntiav thaum peb tsis muaj tsheb.
english: We call a taxi when we do not have a car.

hmong: Kuv taug kev mus tom khw vim nws nyob ze kuv tsev.
english: I walk to the store because it is close to my house.

hmong: Nws khiav ncig lub pas dej txhua tag kis.
english: They run around the lake every morning.

hmong: Peb caij lub nkoj hla lub pas dej thaum ntuj sov.
english: We take a boat across the lake in summer.

hmong: Kuv kawm tsav tsheb nrog kuv txiv.
english: I am learning to drive with my father.
